mechanism_narrative: A low Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor market deterioration
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion (HOUST > 1500) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction of INDPRO and HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production level below 105 (INDPRO < 105) signals a weakening economy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
